items.title: Special termination to avoid price increase
items.quote: Ihre Kündigung muss uns vor diesem Tag in Textform erreichen; Kosten entstehen Ihnen dadurch nicht.
items.computation: The letter grants a special right to terminate without cost if the customer rejects the price change, effective the day the new prices start (01.01.2027). The cancellation must reach the provider 'vor diesem Tag' (before that day), i.e. before 2027-01-01. Counting back one day under § 188 BGB: the day before Friday 1 Jan 2027 is Thursday 31 Dec 2026, which is not a weekend day or a public holiday in Hesse (the provider's seat), so no further shift applies. To be safe, the letter/notice should be sent a few business days earlier so it arrives in time (recommended send-by around 24.12.2026).

items.title: New electricity prices take effect
items.quote: zum 01.01.2027 passen wir die Preise in Ihrem Tarif „Region Basis“ an.
items.computation: The letter states the new prices (Arbeitspreis, Grundpreis, Abschlag) apply starting 01.01.2027; this is the effective date stated directly in the letter, no counting needed.

warnings: The new monthly Abschlag (advance payment) of €92.00 and new unit prices are set unilaterally by the supplier; verify the stated cost reasons (network and procurement costs) if you want to challenge the increase before deciding whether to use the special termination right.

If you want to end the contract to avoid the price increase, make sure your cancellation in Textform (letter, fax or e-mail is typically accepted) actually arrives at Beispielstrom Mittelhessen GmbH by 31.12.2026 — mailing it on the deadline day itself may be too late; sending a few business days earlier is safer.
